audit.why: Content states Yuumi favoured levels 1-5, Nami favoured level 6 onward (win rate 49.79%, packet levelChart Yuumi x4, Nami x3) — matches Aqua Prison being a slow, dodgeable early skillshot that becomes a real all-in tool once Tidal Wave (R) is up.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0-3].side say "Nami" and phases[4-6].side say "Skill" — the exact inverse of content win[] (Yuumi,Yuumi,Yuumi,Yuumi,Nami,Nami,Nami).
audit.why: The full layer has the early/late split backwards from the content layer.
audit.corrected: Flip phases[0-3].side to Yuumi and phases[4-6].side to Nami, with grounded why text.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Aqua Prison as matchup-defining with no cooldown number, and never states that Aqua Prison cancels Yuumi's Final Chapter channel.
audit.why: Missing-interactions data flags your-channel-punished (Q vs R) as applicable and unstated.
audit.corrected: Add the cooldown and the channel-cancel interaction.
